2608.08689.title: A Structural Dynamics Graph World Model: Unified Modeling, Constrained Rollout, and Interpretable Calibration
2608.08689.paper_summary: The state evolution of a complex system arises jointly from object laws, relational propagation, domain conservation, and unmodeled error. Forcing all sources into one black box makes mechanism attribution and constraint preservation unauditable; forcing every mechanism into one equation family discards mature domain solvers. We propose SD-GWM, a Structural Dynamics Graph World Model as an executable structural contract: nodes declare self-dynamics S, edges declare neighbor graph-coupled dynamics N---both fixed-form mechanism assets (rules, ODEs, solvers) calibrating only authorized parameters. An optional bounded residual R concentrates learnability, while a global projection maps states to feasibility, enforcing constraints without guaranteeing accuracy gains. On eight pre-registered research questions, SD-GWM delivers (i) heterogeneous integration: rules and solvers plug in natively; (ii) semantic fidelity: disabling R preserves source semantics bit-for-bit, with four theory properties under explicit proof/empirical boundaries; (iii) auditable governance: stepwise traces enable counterfactual fault localization (top-1 = 1.0) without post-hoc approximations. On a semi-synthetic flood testbed and USGS streamflow, SD-GWM reduces constraint violations to floating-point tolerance in analytical tests and to zero in semi-synthetic and real-data cases. Persistence matches SD-GWM in calm periods, but during a 254-day extreme-flood shift persistence and all neural baselines collapse (90-min RMSE 892-3007 cfs) while SD-GWM holds at 108 cfs (8-28x gain). The bounded residual cuts RMSE ~50% only under backbone bias. We position SD-GWM not as a universally superior forecaster, but as a verifiable substrate for auditable, constraint-safe spatiotemporal mining.
2608.08689.paper_summary_zh: 複雜系統的狀態演變共同源自物體法則、關聯傳播、領域保護和未建模的誤差。將所有來源強行納入一個黑箱使機制歸因和約束保護無法審計；將每個機制強行納入一個方程族則會丟棄成熟的領域求解器。我們提出了 SD-GWM，一種結構動力學圖世界模型，作為可執行的結構合約：節點宣告自動力學 S，邊緣宣告鄰居圖耦合動力學 N——這兩者都是固定形式的機制資產（規則、常微分方程、求解器），僅校準授權參數。一個可選的有界殘差 R 集中學習能力，而全局投影將狀態映射到可行性，強制約束而不保證準確性增益。在八個預註冊的研究問題上，SD-GWM 提供了 (i) 異質整合：規則和求解器原生插入；(ii) 語義忠實：禁用 R 保留源語義逐位不變，並在明確的證明/實證邊界下具有四個理論性質；(iii) 可審計的治理：逐步追蹤使反事實故障定位成為可能（top-1 = 1.0），無需事後近似。在一個半合成的洪水測試平台和 USGS 流量數據上，SD-GWM 將約束違規降低至浮點容忍度，在分析測試中為零，在半合成和實際數據案例中亦然。在平靜期間，持續性與 SD-GWM 相匹配，但在 254 天的極端洪水轉變期間，持續性和所有神經基準崩潰（90 分鐘 RMSE 892-3007 cfs），而 SD-GWM 仍保持在 108 cfs（增益 8-28 倍）。有界殘差僅在主幹偏差下將 RMSE 削減約 50%。我們將 SD-GWM 定位為一種可驗證的基底，用於可審計的、約束安全的時空挖掘，而不是一個普遍優越的預測器。
